system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: each step encompassing access to a screenshot of the current UI and a dynamically generated document detailing the functions of UI elements
system_prompt_style.note: Only README, file tree and paper are available; scripts/prompts.py exists but its contents are not in the evidence. Coded from the paper's prose describing per-step prompts that include a generated document.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent receives two key inputs: a real-time screenshot showing the app's interface and an XML file detailing the interactive elements.
env_context_strategy.note: Two things feed the model. First, UI elements parsed from the XML are injected as numeric labels on the screenshot. Second, the exploration-phase document base is injected. Both combine with agent-driven actions.

context_compaction.note: Paper Sec. 3.3 says a per-step summary is carried forward, but the code is not in the bundle. The history-handling code in scripts/task_executor.py was not provided.

observation_format.evidence_quote: These elements are overlaid as semi-transparent numbers on the screenshot.
observation_format.note: The README also mentions an optional grid overlay.

tool_call_format.note: The model emits function-call-like text such as tap(5), which is parsed from the text. Closest value is code_as_action; this is a mismatch because the text is parsed, not executed as code. The parser in scripts/model.py was not provided.

tool_count.note: The paper lists six actions: tap, long_press, swipe, text, back, exit. The optional grid tool is excluded from the count. These are text actions, not schema tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Our agent's action space mirrors common human interactions with smartphones: taps and swipes.
edit_primitive.note: The action space is GUI-only and has no file editing.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The prompts also provide detailed explanations of all available actions.

protocol_standardization.note: The source files and requirements.txt contents are not in the bundle, so no grep was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: In each step, the agent is first tasked with providing its observations of the current UI, followed by articulating its thought process
loop_primitives.note: The exploration phase (learn.py) is a separate mode with reflection on each action.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: followed by articulating its thought process concerning the task and current observations

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The agent adheres to a step-by-step approach when given a task

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The agent adheres to a step-by-step approach when given a task

human_in_loop.note: Human demonstration is a learning mode, not a gate on the agent's actions. The run loop code was not provided.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: After each action, the agent summarizes the interaction history and the actions taken during the current step. This information is incorporated into the next prompt

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the agent generates documentation for elements interacted during the exploration/demonstration and saves them for use in the deployment phase.

state_persistence.note: The code was not provided, so there was no place to check for resume support.

self_verification.evidence_quote: AppAgent will reflect on its previous action making sure its action adheres to the given task
self_verification.note: This applies only in the exploration mode.

rollback.note: Back() is UI navigation, not rollback of changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: it can exit the process by taking theExit()action.
termination_condition.note: The paper Sec. 4.1 caps steps at 40 for exploration and 10 for testing. Whether the step cap exists in config.yaml could not be verified.

cost_controls.note: README mentions a request-interval setting, which is rate limiting rather than a spend cap. config.yaml contents are not in the bundle.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
download and install [Android Debug Bridge](https://developer.android.com/tools/adb) (adb) which is a
command-line tool
execution_isolation.note: Actions run as host adb commands against a real device or emulator. The quote may not match exactly because it spans a line break.

tracing.note: scripts/step_recorder.py exists in the file tree but its contents were not provided.

eval_hooks.note: The shipped benchmark is a task list (assets/testset.md) with no runner. The file tree has no evaluation script.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an LLM-based multimodal agent framework designed to operate smartphone apps.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: If you want to test AppAgent using your own models, you should write a new model class in `scripts/model.py` accordingly.
model_agnostic.note: Only OpenAI and Qwen are shipped; other models require writing code. There is no litellm abstraction.

first_release_date.note: No tag information was available. The date is the open-sourcing date from the changelog.

pinned_version.note: No release tag is known, so this pins main.

stars.note: No star count is in the evidence.
